speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned sudden-onset lower back pain radiating down your leg; to help me narrow this down, on what side does the pain travel, and does it worsen when you cough or sneeze?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old woman. The patient reports exercising in the gym several hours ago when she suddenly felt a sharp pain in her lower back. She describes the pain as radiating down the side of her leg and into her foot.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Lumbar Radiculopathy (likely L4/L5 disc herniation).

Based on your sudden onset of sharp pain radiating to the foot while exercising, could you tell me if you have any numbness, tingling, or weakness in your foot or leg?
